payload.text: Issue 0711 (vc, 11:33Z, off cc's chain; S, intentsvcs): migrate.rs's collision guard compares paths byte for byte, so on a case-insensitive disk two attachment paths that differ only in case pass it. cc's meaning (dc's inbox from cc, 2026-11-19 11:37Z): refuse, before anything is written, two writes in one batch that some disk this project lives on would store as one file. (1) Fold with std Unicode lowercase (str::to_lowercase), no new crate, and name the limit in the guard's comment: names that differ only by normalisation (NFC against NFD) are not caught. (2) Refuse on every file system, folding every path in the batch, attachments and canon alike. (3) Blocked::Collision { path, other }, with both spellings as written; the remedy says they are one file on a case-insensitive disk (macOS's default) and to give one of the two attachments another name. Proof: a test red on the base and green on the fix, through the cargo gate on a Desk slot. After issue 0714.
